reason: Free is nice, but I already get three quotes from crews myself and compare them on price. I don't see what this adds except a standard brief and a contract, and nothing says who actually checks these crews.
objection: Who verifies these crews, and when a crew walks off halfway through my flat, who do I call? Right now it just says 'to be defined'.
would_change_my_mind: A written verification process for the crews and a clear answer on what happens if a crew stops mid-job, shown to me before I post my brief.
